note: Pfizer's angina trial for sildenafil produced unexpected, sustained erections in participants -- the vasodilatory side effect became the basis for Viagra.
Oral minoxidil for severe hypertension caused unwanted hair growth; reformulated topically, that same side effect became Rogaine.
Topiramate's appetite-suppressant side effect, originally just tolerated in epilepsy/migraine patients, was deliberately combined with phentermine into the weight-loss drug Qsymia.
Bupropion's weight-loss side effect (as an antidepressant) was deliberately combined with naltrexone into the weight-loss drug Contrave.
